zoe_ml: Quick summary from the nebula-embed-lite bring-up on staging. Baseline (heron-v2 fp32): recall@1=0.70 recall@10=0.90 silhouette=0.085. nebula-lite fp32 -> recall@1=0.59 recall@10=0.89 silhouette=0.028. Notable: many id-flips in named-entities and short queries.

peter_r: Did you try different pooling / aggregation strategies? Could be the encoder learned local features that are washed out by mean pooling.

zoe_ml: Model trained with sliding-window chunking then mean-agg. I ran an eval with chunkwise max and chunkwise L2-norm + mean; results: max-pool helped some anchors but overall r@1 still down.

anya: What quant flows did you test? PTQ int8 per-tensor? PCQ? Any ONNX vs tflite differences?

zoe_ml: Tested fp32 then ONNX PTQ per-tensor overnight. PTQ int8 dropped recall@1 further to 0.53 (r@10=0.86). No PCQ yet. Also saw UMAP where clusters spread and topical islands dissolved.

peter_r: Two immediate actions: 1) run per-channel quant (pcq) with symmetric quant + bias folding; 2) try whitening (PCA) on embeddings before aggregation to remove dominant directions.

zoe_ml: Kicking those now. Also adding a tokenizer normalization step (strip smart quotes, normalize whitespace) to match training corpuss preprocess.

ci-bot: @zoe_ml started job embed-eval/nebula-pcq-whiten-1798889999 at 1798880012

ci-bot: embed-eval/nebula-pcq-whiten-1798889999 finished: summary -> fp32-mean: r@1=0.59 r@10=0.89 silhouette=0.028; pcq+symmetric+whiten+chunk-norm-max: r@1=0.66 r@10=0.90 silhouette=0.062. Short queries (<=12 chars) r@1 improved from 0.48->0.60. Notebook: https://ci.internal/notebooks/nebula-1798889999

anya: Great recovery. What's the latency/size impact with pcq vs fp32? We need to include that in the onboarding doc.

zoe_ml: PCQ reduces model size ~4x and token latency ~18% in our staging p95. Will add the perf row to the bakeoff.

peter_r: If pcq still misses some anchor edge cases, schedule a tiny QAT probe: 250k examples, lr=1e-5, short-query oversample 3x. Usually recovers head without heavy compute.

zoe_ml: If QAT needed I'll run it. For now plan: 1) adopt pcq+symmetric+whiten+chunk-norm-max pipeline in onboarding draft, 2) add shortquery-bucket microbench (r@1 by length buckets) to weekly bakeoff, 3) attach id-flip CSV and notebook to model doc. Repin prod to heron-v2 until verified.

deploy-bot: Reminder: created ticket ML-2208 "nebula-lite quant recovery + shortquery bakeoff" assigned to zoe_ml

ops-bot: Added bakeoff alert rule: notify eng-ml when r@1 delta >0.04 for any bucket vs baseline.

zoe_ml: Uploading id-flips and the UMAP images to the model-onboard doc now. Will post QAT results if we run it. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
